scope: Descriptive crossed training-stream/shared-reset bootstrap. Three streams do not establish population coverage or power; frames and endpoints are not independent training replications.

train.unit: Paired training stream; fixed teacher trajectories not resampled

validation.unit: Paired training stream; fixed teacher trajectories not resampled

primary.pairing: One resampled reset panel is shared across resampled training streams; the 2k/10k endpoint columns remain paired
primary.direction: Differences are 2k minus 10k; relative cost gain is 1-C2/C10, relative controls gain is T2/T10-1

confirmation.pairing: One resampled reset panel is shared across resampled training streams; the 2k/10k endpoint columns remain paired
confirmation.direction: Differences are 2k minus 10k; relative cost gain is 1-C2/C10, relative controls gain is T2/T10-1
